selection: live verified replacement/addressable heads and ordinary originals, newest timestamp then lowest complete ID; plaintext previews are absent
relay_masks: pending/accepted/refused use exact nonnegative hexadecimal u64 strings, avoiding JavaScript integer rounding
original: fetch by the full ID through the store event operation; the index is not a signature-verification receipt
relays: immutable journal relay-pool order; item masks index this array, independently of current saved relay settings or the six active SDK sockets
outbox: the outbox operation uses the same row codec but retains all outgoing records, even if an original has expired from ordinary history; completion concerns this projection, separately from pruned history
